hooks.command: AUTO_PAUSE=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path='${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude'; let env={}; try { const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path+'/settings.json','utf8')); env={...env,...(s.env||{})}; } catch(e) {} try { const l=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path+'/settings.local.json','utf8')); env={...env,...(l.env||{})}; } catch(e) {} console.log(env.CLAUDE_MEDIA_AUTO_PAUSE !== undefined ? env.CLAUDE_MEDIA_AUTO_PAUSE : 'true');" 2>/dev/null || echo 'true'); if [ "$AUTO_PAUSE" = "true" ]; then media-control pause 2>/dev/null || true; fi
